info.title: Cisco IOS-XE IETF - ietf-key-chain
info.description:
IETF standard data from `ietf-key-chain` module.

**Root containers:** 1 (key-chains)
**Paths:** 13 | **Operations:** 52

Supports CRUD for read-write nodes, GET for read-only nodes.

get.description:
Retrieve key-chains from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace key-chains on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update key-chains on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove key-chains from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
